usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.fine_tuning.checkpoints.permissions.list("ft-AF1WoRqd3aJAHsqc9NY7iL8F", project_id="project_id", after="after", limit=10, order="ascending")
print(result)

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: The ID of the project to get permissions for.

fields.name: after
fields.description: Identifier for the last permission ID from the previous pagination request.

fields.name: order
fields.description: The order in which to retrieve permissions.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The permission identifier, which can be referenced in the API endpoints.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the permission was created.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: The project identifier that the permission is for.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always "checkpoint.permission".
